title: Application of Cambridge Electric Light Company, under the provisions of G.L. c. 164, §94G. as amended by St. 1981, c. 375, and the Department of Public Utilities of a change in the Power Cost Charge to be billed to the Company's customers pursuant to meter readings in the biling months of April, May and June, 1988. Application is also made by Cambridge Electric Light Company for approval by the Departtment of rates to be paid to Qualifying Facilities fo purchases of power pursuant to 220 C.M.R. 8.00 and M.D.P.U. No. 404. The rules established in 220 C.M.R. 8.00 set forth the fillings to be made by utilities with the Department, and implement the intent of sections 201 and 210 of the Public Utility Regualtory Policies Act of 1978.
